checks.title: Delete product base (truong hop allowed): dialog xac nhan + deletion-check truoc + DELETE tra 204

checks.title: DELETE product base khi deletion-check.policy='blocked' (IN_CAMPAIGNS): server THUC SU CHAN, khong chi la goi y UI (CONFIRMED)
checks.precondition: Co 1 product base dang duoc it nhat 1 campaign dung
steps: Bam 'Delete product' tren product dang duoc 1 campaign dung
Quan sat request GET /api/products/{id}/deletion-check, xac nhan policy='blocked', reason='IN_CAMPAIGNS'
Quan sat dialog Warning hien thi
Xac nhan KHONG co request DELETE nao duoc gui di
checks.observation_point: Response deletion-check + noi dung dialog + su vang mat cua request DELETE
checks.expected_result: Khi bam Delete tren product base dang duoc it nhat 1 campaign su dung, UI hien nut 'View campaign list' thay vi cho xoa; neu bypass UI goi thang DELETE /api/products/{id}, server tra 403 Forbidden va KHONG xoa - day la enforcement that o tang server, khong chi la goi y UI. (Chi tiet: GET /api/products/{id}/deletion-check tra {policy:'blocked', reason:'IN_CAMPAIGNS'}; UI hien dialog Warning nguyen van ('... currently being used in Campaigns. Please remove it from all campaigns before deleting...') voi 2 nut 'View campaigns list'/'Cancel', KHONG CO request DELETE nao duoc gui qua duong UI; tren mot product khac cung dang link campaign, goi THANG DELETE /api/products/{id} bang script bypass hoan toan UI, server tra 403 Forbidden voi body {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"}, re-query xac nhan product KHONG bi xoa.) CONFIRMED_EXPECTED, dong dut diem risk HIGH 'unverified-server-enforcement' cua v1 bang evidence DELETE that o tang server (khong chi suy tu hanh vi an nut cua UI).

checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan 'co duoc chap nhan va behavior giong active', 2026-09-13 ): khi bam Delete tren product base MOI TAO, status ACTIVE, CHUA TUNG archive, GET deletion-check tra {policy:'allowed'}, DELETE /api/products/{id} tra 204 - GIONG HET hanh vi cua product da archive truoc do (KB-059). KHONG bat buoc phai archive truoc khi xoa.
